equation_summary: Per token (naive.py:59-63): S <- S * exp(g_t) with g_t in R^K per-K-CHANNEL log decay (per value head); S <- S + (beta_t * k_t) ⊗ (v_t - k_t^T S_decayed); o_t = q_t^T S with q pre-scaled by 1/sqrt(K). So this is U2.D with channel-diagonal G = Diag(exp(g_t)) along the key axis, scalar beta per head, and read scale 1/sqrt(K) as an explicit, defaulted scale operand (naive.py:48-49,52). GVA head expansion (H qk heads -> HV value heads) is an external repeat_interleave (naive.py:47,52-53).
ledger_verdicts: CONFIRM call graph E[QKV/A_log,dt,bias/norm] ; U2.D(key-channel decay,read scale=1/sqrt(K)) ; E[gated output]: g is computed externally from A_log/dt_bias (fla/layers/kda.py:176-184,252-269) and the mixer takes g:[B,T,HV,K] channel decay + scalar beta, exactly channel-diagonal U2.D.

CONFIRM read scale is a descriptor field: scale is an explicit optional argument defaulting to K^-0.5 (naive.py:18,48-49), applied to q before the recurrence (naive.py:52) — matches the ledger's 'read scale=1/sqrt(K)' as a semantic field, not a baked constant.

CONFIRM blockers B[channel-decay delta native envelope] (channel-diagonal G on the delta law is beyond plain U2.D envelope) and exact gate/cache ABI (initial_state added at naive.py:56-57, final state returned).
direction_justification: KDA is exactly the canonical U2.D law with channel-scope diagonal decay and an explicit read-scale field, both of which the K2 gated contract names as semantic fields — blocked only on B[K2_graph_execution] plus the channel-decay native envelope.
open_questions: Whether GVA (HV value heads sharing H qk heads via repeat_interleave) should be a K2 descriptor head-map field analogous to K1's query-to-KV map, or always an external expand — currently external in source.
Whether use_beta_sigmoid_in_kernel / negative-eigenvalue beta*2 are numerical-policy fields of the descriptor or external (currently kernel flags in layer).
